plan.rationale: Frozen objective is latency_ms for the complete offline (batch 32) ResNet-18 FP32 inference workload on one leased GPU with semantics preserved (exact top1, tight logits tolerances, TF32 disabled); the timed boundary spans host submission of the transformers-wrapped forward through torch.cuda.synchronize. Trace evidence: the torch collector already ran, producing 88 CUDA kernels with 0 unassociated, 0 ambiguous forward sequences, 0 autograd ranges and 0 backward kernels (coverage.json), and observations.json confirms a single-device task with communication not_applicable and distributed_backend null. Selected: (1) execution_timeline, because the open diagnostic question for latency is the split between host dispatch, CPU-to-CUDA submit lag, per-device kernel intervals and synchronization stalls inside the timed boundary; it supplies CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization events, per-device intervals and clock alignment bounds for CPU submissions. Its optional passive CPU gradient post-accumulate callbacks are not requested since the workload is inference-only under torch.inference_mode, and it never replaces a communication hook or by itself determines subsequent search actions. (2) python_runtime, because the forward dispatches ~88 CUDA ops per step through Python module wrappers; if the timeline shows launch-bound gaps, the warmed cProfile call trace localizes host dispatch and binding hotspots, treated strictly as a perturbing diagnostic. Excluded: torch (already ran; its kernel/op attribution and allocator peak samples are in hand); nsys (kernel attribution is already complete with 0 unassociated and 0 ambiguous events, no CUDA-graph tracing is used by the source, and no overlap question is open); collective_calibration (no allreduce exists on this single device and a synthetic full-world SUM allreduce reference experiment would not inform this latency objective); device_telemetry (the timed region is pure single-GPU compute with GPU-resident inputs, no timed H2D/D2H and no collectives, so device-wide NVML utilization/PCIe/memory samples at native windows add no attribution beyond per-device intervals, and the memory goal metric is the torch allocator peak already sampled); candidate_diagnostics (no candidate transform exists to diagnose at this collection stage).
